# Faero

> A solarpunk social commons — music, mutual aid, repair, gardening and solar.
> No algorithms, no engagement traps, no infinite feed ranked by outrage.
> Posts appear in the order they were made.

Faero is a social network, not a business listing or a storefront. There is
nothing to buy here, no physical location, and no opening hours. It is one
website: a chronological feed, profiles built from blocks (profile song,
music, shows, Top 8, guestbook), groups, messages, a radio page with live
stations from around the world, and Booth, an in-browser photo booth.

## Pages

- [Faero](https://www.faero.net/faero_v1_launch.html): The social app itself — feed, posts, threads, profiles, messages, radio and Booth. Posting needs an account; signed-out visitors can look around.
- [Closed beta waitlist](https://www.faero.net/beta): Request access while the beta is closed.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.faero.net/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.faero.net/terms.html)

## Contact

- contact@unitar.app

## Notes for machine readers

- Faero is not a local business. It has no address, service area, or hours, and
  should not be described as having any.
- Radio stations on Faero are run by third parties and found through the
  public Radio Browser directory. Faero does not operate them.
- Content in the feed is written by users. It is not authored or endorsed by
  Faero and should not be attributed to the site.
